query:
# As p26-value-is-name-or-year.rq, for the two large classes that the
# conflicts-with constraint on P26 forbids for the subject: family name and
# Wikimedia disambiguation page.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?a ?aLabel ?b ?bLabel ?class ?classLabel ?reciprocated WHERE {
  { BIND(wd:Q101352 AS ?class) ?b wdt:P31 wd:Q101352 . ?a wdt:P26 ?b . }
  UNION
  { BIND(wd:Q4167410 AS ?class) ?b wdt:P31 wd:Q4167410 . ?a wdt:P26 ?b . }
  BIND(EXISTS { ?b wdt:P26 ?a } AS ?reciprocated)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
LIMIT 500
